content:
{'translation': "The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said it has taken statements regarding the case. The dog involved is currently under observation at an Animal Management Centre under the department's jurisdiction.", 'translation_lzh': '漁護署表示，已就有關個案錄取口供。涉事狗隻正在署方轄下動物管理中心接受觀察。'}

{'translation': 'The AFCD stated that on July 10, the dog involved had previously been detained in connection with another dog-biting incident. When the owner retrieved the dog, the AFCD had issued a warning that the dog must be securely restrained by a leash not exceeding two metres in length in public places, and properly controlled, so as not to cause nuisance or injury to other people or animals.', 'translation_lzh': '漁護署表示，7 月 10 日，涉事狗隻曾因涉及另一宗咬傷狗隻個案被扣留，畜養人領回時，漁護署已警告必須在公共地方使用一條長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥地牽引該狗隻，並對其作出適當控制，以免對其他人或動物造成滋擾或傷害。'}

{'translation': "The owner of Vivi, the Bichon Frise that was killed, posted a tribute on social media today. The owner said Vivi loved going out and was taken for walks twice a day. Yesterday, while walking at a pet garden, a large dog half a person's height suddenly rushed out and bit Vivi on the neck.", 'translation_lzh': '被咬死的小比熊薇薇的主人今日在社交媒體發文悼念。主人說，薇薇喜歡落街，每天散步兩次。昨日到寵物公園散步，不料突然有一隻半個人高的大狗衝出，一口咬住薇薇的頸項。'}

{'translation': 'The owner recalled trying various methods, including kicking the large dog, spraying water at its nose, and using treats to lure it away, but the dog refused to release its grip on Vivi. The owner said: "I screamed for help and am grateful to the caring passers-by who assisted, but faced with a large dog weighing dozens of pounds that refused to let go, no one could do anything. I could only watch helplessly as my little dog lost her life."', 'translation_lzh': '主人憶述，當時嘗試了多種方法，包括踢向大狗、用水噴鼻、用零食引開，但大狗死口咬著薇薇不放。主人說：「我尖叫求救，感謝熱心途人相助，但面對幾十磅的大狗死口不放，大家都沒辦法，我只能眼睜睜看著自己的小狗失去生命。」'}

{'translation': 'Vivi died on the spot. The owner recalled that the large dog continued to guard Vivi\'s remains until police arrived and restrained it, only then was the owner able to collect the body. "I later learned that the vicious dog had also killed another small dog. From start to finish, the large dog\'s owner never showed up."', 'translation_lzh': '薇薇當場命喪。主人憶述，大狗仍守著薇薇遺體，直到警方到場把牠控制住，主人才能收拾遺體。「後來我才得知，那隻惡犬還咬死了另一隻小狗。由始到終，大狗主人並沒出現。」'}

{'translation': 'The owner said the family is deeply saddened by the sudden tragedy and has been unable to sleep all night. "Vivi was an exceptionally well-behaved and gentle little dog, our family\'s little angel. I really want to hold her and kiss her again. I can\'t believe she has suddenly left us like this." The owner uploaded the last video of Vivi before the incident, showing her sitting in a stroller in a shopping mall, looking adorable and well-behaved. The owner said: "Only by repeatedly watching her curious and adorable expression can I temporarily forget the horrifying scene."', 'translation_lzh': '主人說，面對驟然慘劇，一家人十分傷痛，徹夜難眠。「薇薇是一隻特別乖、特別溫馴的小狗，是我們全家人的小天使。我好想再抱著她、親親她。不敢相信她就這樣突然離我們而去。」主人上載了薇薇事發前最後的錄影，是薇薇坐在 BB 車內、於商場乖巧可愛的片段。主人說：「只有反覆看著她可愛好奇的樣子，才能暫時忘記可怕景象。」'}

{'translation': "The AFCD pointed out that under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation, large dogs weighing 20 kilograms or more must be securely restrained by a leash not exceeding two metres in length in public places. Violators may be fined $25,000 and sentenced to three months' imprisonment.", 'translation_lzh': '漁護署指，根據《危險狗隻規例》，重達 20 公斤或以上的大型狗隻，在公眾地方須以不超逾兩米狗帶穩妥地牽引，違例可被判處罰款 2.5 萬元及監禁三個月。'}

{'translation': 'According to Section 23 of the Rabies Ordinance, dogs must be restrained by a leash or otherwise properly controlled when in a public place, or elsewhere if it can reasonably be expected that the dog may roam into a public place. Violators may be fined $10,000.', 'translation_lzh': '根據《狂犬病條例》第 23 條，狗隻在公眾地方時或在其他地方而按常理可預料狗隻會遊蕩至公眾地方時，必須以狗帶牽引或以其他方式妥善控制，違例可被判處罰款一萬元。'}

{'translation': "Under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Ordinance, any person who wantonly or unreasonably commits or omits an act that causes any animal unnecessary suffering commits an offence. Upon conviction, the maximum penalty is a fine of $200,000 and three years' imprisonment.", 'translation_lzh': '而根據《防止殘酷對待動物條例》，任何人胡亂或不合理地作出或不作出某種作為，而導致任何動物受到任何不必要的痛苦，即屬違法，一經定罪，最高可處罰款 20 萬元及監禁三年。'}
